SashaMIT opened PR #14621 from SashaMIT:fix/atomic-memflags-print to bytecodealliance:main:

Issue #14572.

atomic_rmw and atomic_cas were printed without their memory flags. A big read-modify-write came back as native endian, so the round trip changed the result. The report's example returns 0x01020314 instead of 0x11020304.

Load and store already print MemFlags. These two arms now do the same. cranelift/filetests/filetests/parser/atomic-memflags.clif checks big on atomic_rmw and little on atomic_cas. With the old arms, filecheck misses both lines.

Printing CLIF and parsing it again is enough to lose the endianness. No guest or host authority is involved. The parser already accepted the flags.

Made with Cursor
